_meta.title: Germany: right-wing violent offences, 2025 (one by one)
_meta.what_it_measures: Each violent offence classed as right-wing politically motivated crime in 2025 that the Länder reported to the BKA, with date, town, Land, offence and whether it is flagged as hate crime. Coordinates are not yet added (see places_to_geocode.json).
_meta.licence: Bundestag printed papers are official works without copyright: "Drucksachen und Plenarprotokolle genießen als amtliche Werke keinen urheberrechtlichen Schutz" (https://www.bundestag.de/services/impressum). Source must be named (§63 UrhG) and content must not be altered (§62 UrhG).
_meta.coordinates: Each offence is drawn at the OpenStreetMap point (Nominatim) for the town the Bundestag annex names, within its Land; the annex gives no address. ODbL for the coordinates.
